causes.what: watch_rehearsal's unmet group is OR, so once she has met Cross but not Brooke (or the reverse) the met one is still 'the drama teacher' / 'a blonde girl' and Cross speaks as an unknown.
Neither repeat ends on a hook: 'You stay in your seat longer than you meant to.' and 'Your face goes hot anyway.' point at nothing next.
The rehearsal is charged ('Like you want it') but her reaction is off her body: no body part, no reaction to her, no 'not yet'.
Nobody reacts to her on either repeat ('Nobody turns round.'), and PLAN.md doesn't declare that nobody does.
watch_rehearsal and watch_class have hours and no daily count, yet hide out of hours instead of greying with their hours (C913, C916); clock.md rule 10 covers only clock-plus-count rows.
watch_class opens at 11:30 though Cross teaches from 11:00, placed around 'Go to drama' to avoid the clash (L166).
